shots.prompt: Young Indian professional seated at a tidy apartment desk, holding a phone and asking an uncertain question; slow camera push-in; soft morning window light; curious, grounded mood.

shots.prompt: Single hand hovering between two interview appointments on a paper calendar with no readable text; overhead camera drift; warm natural light; thoughtful mood.

Yeh result ki prediction nahi, timing awareness hai, plain English mein. Confirm karne se pehle apna grid dekh lo.
